findings: The exact catalog song failed in desktop Chrome too; this is not evidence of an iPhone-only defect.
The public normal YouTube watch pages declare both primary recordings playable. This does not establish successful audio playback in Pletina.
The current VISIONOS request is rejected for the matching Music and WEB sources before an audio URL is loaded.
An iOS request variant returns MP4 descriptors, but actual HTMLAudio fails with MediaError 4 and ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB, without progress. It was not adopted.
WEB_EMBEDDED and ANDROID_VR variants do not provide a working direct source in the tested transport and were not adopted.

A separate resolver bug prevented WEB expansion after high-confidence Music sources failed. Bounded recovery is fixed without lowering matching thresholds or changing provider-client production settings.
